units.source_text: 父亲开始说胡话了。

en.t: Father began talking deliriously.

units.source_text: “我对不起乃木大将……

en.t: I have wronged General Nogi...

units.source_text: 真没脸见人……

en.t: I am truly too ashamed to face anyone...

units.source_text: 我这就跟着您老去……”

en.t: I will follow after you at once...

units.source_text: 父亲不时地说出这样的怪话。

en.t: Father would say strange things like this from time to time.

units.source_text: 母亲很害怕，想让大家尽量都守在父亲枕边。

en.t: Mother was frightened and wanted everyone to stay by Father's bedside as much as possible.

units.source_text: 清醒的时候，感觉非常孤寂的病人，好像也希望看到大家。

en.t: When he was clearheaded, the sick man, feeling terribly lonely, seemed to want to see everyone too.

units.source_text: 特别是当他四下张望，看不到母亲的时候，一定会问“阿光呢？”

en.t: Especially when he looked around and could not see Mother, he was sure to ask, "Where is Omitsu?"

units.source_text: 即便不问，他的眼神也在问。

en.t: Even when he did not ask, his eyes asked the question.

units.source_text: 我常常起身去叫母亲。

en.t: I often got up and went to call Mother.

units.source_text: “有什么事吗？”母亲放下手中的活计，来到病房。

en.t: "Is something the matter?" Mother would put down the work in her hands and come to the sickroom.

units.source_text: 父亲有时只是呆呆地盯着母亲的脸，什么话也不说，

en.t: Sometimes Father would only stare blankly at Mother's face and say nothing,

units.source_text: 有时又会说些毫不相干的事情。

en.t: and at other times he would say things that had nothing to do with anything.

units.source_text: 还有的时候，他忽然说：“阿光，我也给你添了不少麻烦啊。”

en.t: At other times he would suddenly say, "Omitsu, I have caused you a great deal of trouble too."

units.source_text: 母亲每次听到这样温柔的话时，眼睛里便噙满了泪水。

en.t: Whenever Mother heard such gentle words, her eyes filled with tears.

units.source_text: 可随后，母亲必定会联想起身体健壮时的父亲。

en.t: But afterward Mother would always think back to Father when he had been healthy and strong.

units.source_text: “他说得多可怜哪，以前他可不是这样的。”

en.t: "How pitifully he talks now, but he was not like that before."

units.source_text: 母亲讲起父亲拿笤帚抽打她后背等往事。

en.t: Mother began telling old stories, such as how Father had beaten her back with a broom.

units.source_text: 这些事，以前我和哥哥听母亲说过好多次。

en.t: My brother and I had heard Mother tell these stories many times before.

units.source_text: 可这回跟以往不同，我们感觉母亲的话听起来就像是对父亲的追忆。

en.t: But this time was different from before; Mother's words sounded to us like reminiscences of Father.

units.source_text: 父亲虽然凝视着自己眼前出现的死亡阴影，

en.t: Although Father gazed at the shadow of death that had appeared before his eyes,

units.source_text: 却还是没有说出算得上遗嘱的话来。

en.t: he still did not say anything that could be called a will.

units.source_text: “趁着父亲还清醒，要不要问一问哪。”

en.t: "While Father is still clearheaded, should we ask him something?"

units.source_text: 哥哥看着我说。

en.t: My brother looked at me and said this.
